verses.text: For the music director, on an eight-stringed lyre. A psalm of David. Help, LORD! The godly are gone, and faithful people are disappearing.
Everyone lies to their neighbor. They flatter with their lips while hiding what’s in their hearts.
May the LORD silence every flattering lip and every boasting tongue,
all those who say, “Our words will put us on top. Our lips are our own. Who can tell us what to do?”
“The weak are oppressed and the needy are groaning, so I’ll rise up now,” says the LORD. “I’ll keep them safe from those who speak against them.”
The LORD’s words are flawless, like silver refined in a clay furnace and purified seven times.
You’ll protect them, LORD, and keep them safe from this generation forever.
The wicked strut everywhere when people praise what is vile.
